test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The strength of magnetic field inside a long current-carrying straight solenoid is:

options.text: more at the end than the centre
uniform at all points inside the solenoid

solution:
The correct answer is __**uniform at all points inside the solenoid.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ** solenoid**__

 __
 
• 
 
A solenoid is a machine made of a casing,** a coil of wire, and a moving plunger (armature).**

 
 
• 
 
A magnetic field that generates around the coil when an electrical current is applied pulls the plunger in.

 
 
• 
 
A solenoid, to put it simply,** transforms electrical energy into mechanical work.**

 
 
• 
 
A solenoid operates by creating an electromagnetic field surrounding an armature, which is a moving core.

 
 
• 
 
The **electromagnetic field **causes that armature to move, and when it does, it opens and closes valves or switches, converting electrical energy into mechanical motion and force.

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
